audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side is flat 'Skill' on every row while content win[] already carries the real chart (Neeko-Neeko-Neeko-Skill-Neeko-Skill-Zilean). The two layers disagree on who wins Levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and 2+ items.
audit.why: Neeko's Blooming Burst/Tangle-Barbs poke-and-root punishes Zilean's immobility early, Pop Blossom swings Level 6 back to her, and Chronoshift plus speed-ups flip the lane once Zilean has 2+ items — this matches the 57.04% Zilean-favored overall win rate resolving late.
audit.corrected: phases[0/1/2/4].side -> Neeko, phases[6].side -> Zilean, with matching why text; phases[3].side stays Skill (already agrees with win[3]).

audit.why: Power spikes are already covered: Level 3 double-bomb, Level 6 Pop Blossom, first item chip, 2-item Chronoshift flip are named with real ability names in spikes[] and breakdown.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Tangle-Barbs as matchup-defining but carries no number, and several fields misgender Neeko as 'he/his' (she/her).
audit.corrected: Added Tangle-Barbs' real cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10) and fixed pronouns in loading, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[2].t, report[10].t.
